value.notes: Controlled list of ticked checkbox values.

allValues.notes: Every value in the group; required for the parent/select-all checkbox to compute its state.

dataAttributes: data-disabled — present when the group is disabled
data-valid/data-invalid, data-dirty/data-touched, data-filled, data-focused — inherited Field state when wrapped in Field.Root

renderProp.elementForm: render={<div />} or compose into Fieldset: <Fieldset.Root render={<CheckboxGroup defaultValue={[]} />}> (documented in the forms handbook)

formIntegration.nameValue: The individual Checkbox.Root children carry name (and value) and submit; the group itself has no name prop.
formIntegration.hiddenInput: Delegated to each Checkbox.Root hidden input; the group renders role="group" with aria-labelledby wired from the labelable context.
formIntegration.validation: Use Field.Root name + Field.Error around the group; group state is exposed to Field as an array.

keyboard.keys: None added by the group — arrow-key movement is not implemented (unlike RadioGroup); each checkbox keeps its own native activation and its own tab stop.
keyboard.focus: No roving tabindex: every checkbox is separately tabbable.

notableDifferences: React Aria's CheckboxGroup offers orientation + roving arrow-key navigation between options; Base UI's CheckboxGroup adds none of that — Tab visits each checkbox.
The group is only a shared-state container: value/defaultValue are string[] of checkbox values (React Aria accepts arbitrary string[] too, so this maps cleanly).
Select-all is a first-class modelled concept (parent on the child + allValues on the group) rather than something you assemble from useCheckboxGroup().
